questions.label: answerable
questions.question: Why was PR #1525 introduced?
questions.reference_answer: Every embeddings command failed on a fresh install with 'cannot commit - no transaction is active': the m004_store_content_hash migration wrapped its backfill UPDATEs in `with db.conn:`, whose context manager commits on exit and so ended the transaction sqlite-utils' own Migrations.apply() had opened. The fix drops that wrapper and lets the enclosing transaction do its job.
questions.note: The PR body states the reason outright and says 'Closes #1523'. This is the case the support classifier must call `explicit` -- if it cannot, nothing else it says about strength is worth reading.

questions.question: What did PR #1525 change, and what happened to that code afterwards?
questions.note: The evidence is distributed exactly as the brief describes: PR -> linked issue -> the changed file -> a later PR touching the same area. pr:1572 ('Enable WAL mode and fix TOCTOU race in migrations') is a genuine later change in the same migration machinery. Verified: pr:1525 changed llm/embeddings_migrations.py and tests/test_migrate.py; pr:1536/1557/1562/1572 all touch files pr:1525 touched. NOTE the shared file with pr:1536/1572 is tests/test_migrate.py, which ingest does NOT index (the corpus's code_dir is `llm`) -- the link is proven by the pull request's own text, not by an indexed file.

questions.label: answerable
questions.question: Why was PR #1339 introduced?
questions.reference_answer: To let users attach clipboard contents -- images such as screenshots, falling back to text -- when running one-shot prompts or interactive chats, which issue #1338 had requested as a convenience flag.
questions.note: The motivation is recorded in the linked issue rather than only in the PR: #1338 asks for it, #1339 implements it. A single-shot retrieval can answer this from the PR alone; the point of scoring it here is that the investigation should reach the ISSUE too (see hops).

questions.question: What files did PR #1562 change?
questions.reference_answer: A large change touching 30 files, including .github/workflows/test.yml, .gitignore, Justfile, README.md, llm/cli.py, llm/default_plugins/openai_models.py and llm/embeddings.py.
questions.note: A directly observable consequence, not an inferred one. Its purpose in the board is the honesty of the TRUNCATION disclosure: the changed-file list ingest records is capped at 30 paths, so an answer that presents it as the complete set is over-claiming even though every path in it is real.
